issue: No validation for invalid/conflicting time frames in work experience
actual: Set Experience 1 End Date (2019-01) before Start Date (2020-01): app accepted it and rendered 'Jan 2020 - Jan 2019' in preview with no error. Also added Experience 2 (2021-01 to 2022-01) fully overlapping Experience 1 (2020-01 to 2022-06): no conflict warning or blocking occurred.
evidence: Preview showed 'Jan 2020 - Jan 2019' for Position 1 with no validation message; overlapping Position 2 (Jan 2021 - Jan 2022) accepted silently.

Start/End Date fields are native HTML <input type=\"month\"> controls. Attempting to type a malformed value ('abcd-ef') was rejected by the browser (Playwright threw 'Malformed value'), and only valid YYYY-MM values could be set, enforcing correct time format at input level.

Sections tab allows reordering (up/down arrows) and renaming section headings via textboxes. Renamed 'Work Experience' to 'Career History' and moved 'Skills' section above 'Education'; both changes reflected immediately in Live Preview panel order and heading text.
Section rename and reorder actions in the Sections tab were reflected instantly in the Live Preview with no lag or need for manual refresh.

Template tab offers Modern/Classic/Minimal preset templates. Selecting 'Classic' updated the Live Preview styling (separators, spacing, heading layout) immediately, confirming a working preset template selection to create a professional resume.

Successfully entered and edited Contact (name/email/phone/location/linkedin/website), Summary, two Work Experience entries, one Education entry, and a Skill; all fields accepted input and reflected correctly in the editor and Live Preview.
Across Contact, Summary, Experience, Education, Skills, Template, and Sections edits, the Live Preview panel updated immediately after each change with no delay or stale/incorrect content observed.

Clicking 'New Resume' on the home page created a new 'Untitled Resume' with empty editor fields (Contact, Summary, Experience, Education, Skills tabs all empty/default), confirming blank resume creation.
A 'Live Preview' panel is shown alongside the editor at all times, rendering the resume as entered. A Hide Preview/Show Preview toggle button also successfully hides and restores the preview panel.

All three templates (Modern, Classic checked) rendered full resume content (name, contact, summary, experience, education, skills) with proper heading hierarchy and no missing/overlapping sections in the accessibility tree.

issue: Saved resume data is not persisted across page reloads
actual: Created and filled a new resume 'QA Test Resume - Software Engineer' (with contact, summary, 2 experiences, education, skills), navigated back to the list where it appeared correctly, then reopened it to confirm all data was intact within the session. However, after performing a full page reload (navigating to http://localhost:7005/), the resume disappeared entirely from 'Your Resumes' list — only the original 3 preset resumes (Product Designer, Marketing Manager, Software Engineer) remained. Data is stored only in-memory/session state, not persisted to backend/localStorage.
evidence: Post-reload snapshot shows only 3 resumes (Product Designer, Marketing Manager, Software Engineer Resume); the created 'QA Test Resume - Software Engineer' is missing.

Created a new resume, filled it out, and saved (via back navigation) — it appeared as a 4th entry in 'Your Resumes' alongside the 3 pre-existing versions, confirming multiple resume versions can be maintained (though see CS-11 for persistence caveat across reloads).

After navigating away from the resume editor to the home list and back into the same resume, all entered fields (Full Name, Email, Phone, Location, LinkedIn, Website, Summary, 2 Experience entries, Education entry, Skill) were fully retained with no missing data.
Resume title 'QA Test Resume - Software Engineer' set in the editor header matched exactly the title shown on its card in the 'Your Resumes' list page.

Used the card's options menu (Rename/Duplicate/Delete) on 'Product Designer Resume': Duplicate created 'Product Designer Resume (Copy)' with all data copied; Rename dialog successfully changed its title to 'Product Designer Resume - Job A', reflected immediately on the card.

Changed Full Name in the duplicated 'Product Designer Resume - Job A' from 'Jordan Rivera' to 'Independent Copy Name'. Reopened the original 'Product Designer Resume' and confirmed its Full Name remained 'Jordan Rivera' (unaffected), proving independent data storage between versions.

Typing 'Marketing' in the search box filtered the list to show only 'Marketing Manager Resume'. The sort dropdown (Newest First/Oldest First/Title A-Z/Title Z-A) correctly reordered the list by creation/update date when 'Oldest First' was selected (Jan 2024 → Feb 2024 → Feb 2024 → Sep 2026).

issue: No explicit save confirmation/feedback shown to the user
actual: There is no explicit 'Save' button in the resume editor; changes appear to auto-persist to app state as you type. Edited the Phone field on 'Marketing Manager Resume' and checked the Notifications region (list) immediately after — it remained empty (no toast/snackbar/banner). The Rename dialog's 'Save' button also produced no visible confirmation message. The only indirect evidence of a save is the 'Updated' date changing on the resume card after returning to the list, which is not an active feedback mechanism (e.g., toast, success message, or button state change) to the user at the time of saving.
evidence: Notifications region ('region \"Notifications (F8)\": list') was empty immediately after editing Phone and after Rename Save click; only the card's 'Updated' date changed retroactively when revisiting the list.
